_comment: Ground truth for the eval clips. See docs/MLFLOW_GUIDE.md §11. 0-people clips (mannequin, hand_ad) -> every detection is a false positive; fp_object_count is how many distinct FP objects exist (8 mannequins / 1 printed hand-ad). clip_cashier has 16 distinct people, peak 14. Phase 2 (optional): per_frame map {frame_index: people_count}.

hand_on_ad_in_store.mp4.fp_object_note: single printed image of a human hand on an in-store advertisement; no real people. Tests the FP mode RT-DETR does NOT solve (detection_experiments Case 3).
